notes: Class choice: the consumer resolves four rmw API functions that the provider never defined (they were added to the rmw API and to rmw_fastrtps_cpp by the EventsExecutor work, PR #468 merged 2022-02-24, but not to rmw_fastrtps_dynamic_cpp); there is no class for an element that was never present at the provider, so `other` is used rather than element_removed_or_renamed. Operation: PAIR, because both units are at contemporaneous master revisions and the provider lags the API the consumer resolves; it is not an UPGRADE in the defined sense (the provider is not newer than what the consumer was written against). The last error in the log, "'Expected lexeme type (19) not found, search ended at index 74, at /home/ivanpauno/ros2_ws/src/ros2/rcl/rcl/src/rcl/lexer_lookahead.c:239'", is an unrelated rcl error-state overwrite. PR #598 (best_available QoS, in the fix refs) only cross-references this issue because its author saw rmw_fastrtps_dynamic_cpp test failures; it is not part of the resolution. Commits 27eff0cd12f373cec72a2b1f1ce1d4dcec9eca8d, 3214dcc11896ac6a4c6b5377aca9c5c43ba8c31a and ed69f32ce7cebaec33dab6f9de6978c14ba3f3d7 are the same change on other bases/branches (PR branch iterations), and the timonegk fork commits carry the same message "Add EventExecutor to rmw_fastrtps_dynamic_cpp ... Fixes #599." A follow-up upstream PR #602 "Allow null arguments in the EventsExecutor parameters" (12e514de0d2175b095d420596dc4b661839f570d) is not among the refs.
